article.title: Oraciones nominales rusas en presente
article.chapter: Nominativo y cópula cero en presente — Именительный падеж и нулевая связка

claims.summary: University of Kansas’s Между нами explains that Russian nominal sentences do not express “to be” overtly in the present; the source contrasts past/future, where forms of быть are expressed.
Она врач and Он учитель are the exact present nominal sentence examples supplied by the University of Kansas resource.
Both Russian sentences and their interpretations are reproduced from the source section.
This article restricts the statement to the present nominal examples in the cited passage and excludes existential есть and uncited case analysis.

locator.description: Между нами, “Past Forms of the Verb быть,” lines 159–168: lines 160–161 explicitly contrast nominal sentences in present (Она врач / Он учитель) with past/future forms; lines 163–168 list past forms.

links.notes: Article was narrowed to the source’s exact present nominal examples and stated tense contrast.
